text: [35] pañcime bhikkhave dāne ānisaṃsā katame pañca bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo santo sappurisā bhajanti kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati gihidhammā anapagato 5 hoti #1 ma. sīhāti natthi . 2 ma. yu. yaso ca vaḍḍhati . 3 ma. yu. nandanaṃ . #4 ma. yu. ramanti sagge . 5 yu. anapeto . kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati ime kho bhikkhave pañca dāne ānisaṃsāti . dadamāno piyo hoti sataṃ dhammaṃ anukkamaṃ santo naṃ sadā bhajanti saññatā brahmacārayo te tassa dhammaṃ desenti sabbadukkhāpanūdanaṃ yaṃ so dhammaṃ idhaññāya parinibbātanāsavoti 1 .
